decision.rationale: Attempt 003 is operationally invalid because one provider request failed under the immutable zero-retry rule. The incomplete run also shows repeated schema drift, so authority is revoked and another transport retry is prohibited pending a method-level construction decision.
limitations: Only seven clusters began processing, so fallback, rejection, and semantic rates are incomplete diagnostics rather than population estimates.
No development dataset or T0 response was persisted, so dataset and product quality are not estimable.
No final 10,000-case, true-visual, professor-fidelity, private-course, or usability evidence was produced.
